articles.title: Democratic “Moderation” Isn’t What Produced the Wave
articles.dek: You can watch this episode of Right Now With Perry Bacon above or by following this show on YouTube or Substack . You can read a transcript here . articles.title: Abdul El-Sayed’s Victory Is Historic for These Two Reasons
articles.dek: Abdul El-Sayed’s election is a watershed moment in American politics.
